title: About Proud Tek: RFID and NFC Manufacturer in Shenzhen since 2008
summary: Proud Tek Co., Limited is a Shenzhen-based manufacturer of custom RFID and NFC products with two self-owned factories, an in-house engineering team and 18 years of continuous operation. We supply multiple continents with chip-level customization, encoding, anti-metal lamination, laser numbering and program-specific compliance documentation.
heroPoints: Founded 2008 in Shenzhen; two self-owned factories with in-house wet-inlay, lamination, encoding and printing.
191 SKU variants across 6 product families with chip-level customization and OEM/white-label by default.
ISO 9001 quality system with documented RoHS, REACH, FCC, CE compliance for every shipment.

sections.title: Who Proud Tek serves
sections.intro: We work primarily with engineering-led B2B buyers: system integrators, OEMs, brand-protection programs, hospitality groups, industrial laundries, retail chains, libraries, healthcare networks and event organizers. Most of our customers come back for second and third programs because the engineering conversation continues across deployments.
bullets: System integrators sourcing chip-validated SKUs for new deployments.
OEM and white-label resellers needing direct factory pricing.
Hospitality groups (hotels, resorts, cruise lines) on key-card refresh cycles.
Industrial laundries running PPS, silicone or textile RFID tag programs.
Retail chains operating UHF source-tagging mandates.
Library networks running ISO 15693 self-service kiosks.
Brand owners running NFC anti-counterfeit and digital-product-passport programs.
Event organizers (festivals, conferences, resorts) deploying cashless wristbands.

sections.title: How we manufacture
sections.intro: Proud Tek operates two self-owned facilities in Shenzhen. Wet inlay, anti-metal lamination, card lamination, hot stamping, screen printing, laser numbering and encoding all happen in-house. We do not outsource the value-added steps that buyers care about for traceability and compliance.
bullets: Wet-inlay assembly: NXP, Infineon, Impinj, Alien chips bonded to PET/PI antennas.
Card lamination: PVC, ABS, PETG, wood, recycled-PVC, transparent stocks.
Anti-metal lamination: ferrite-backed inlays for on-metal asset tagging.
Encoding: UID locking, NDEF programming, GS1 SGTIN-96, custom block writes.
Marking: laser engraving, hot stamping, screen printing, 4-color offset.
Quality control: 100% functional read test on every encoded SKU.
Packaging: bulk poly bags, individual sleeves, retail blister, custom branded boxes.

sections.title: Compliance and documentation
sections.intro: We treat compliance documentation as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought. Every shipment ships with the declarations buyers need; certified test reports are available on request when a program requires them.
bullets: Standards: ISO/IEC 14443-3 (HF), ISO/IEC 15693 (vicinity), ISO/IEC 18000-6C (UHF EPC).
Materials: RoHS, REACH SVHC, California Prop 65 declarations on file.
Radio: FCC Part 15 / 18, CE EN 300 330, MIC (Japan), CCC (China).
Quality system: ISO 9001:2015 certified.
Sustainability: recycled-PVC stocks and FSC-certified paper labels available.
EU compliance: EU DPP / Battery Regulation 2023/1542 technical-file support.

faq.question: How long has Proud Tek been operating?
faq.answer: Proud Tek Co., Limited was founded in 2008 in Shenzhen. We have operated continuously for 18 years and have shipped to multiple continents during that time.

faq.question: Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?
faq.answer: We are a manufacturer. Proud Tek operates two self-owned factories in Shenzhen with in-house wet-inlay assembly, lamination, encoding and printing. We do not act as a sourcing intermediary.

faq.question: What certifications do you hold?
faq.answer: We hold ISO 9001:2015 quality system certification. Products are RoHS, REACH SVHC, FCC, CE, MIC and CCC compliant per chip family. Specific test reports (TÜV, SGS) can be commissioned for certification audits.

faq.question: Can you support EU DPP and Battery Regulation programs?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide UHF and NFC tag families compatible with EU Digital Product Passport requirements and Battery Regulation 2023/1542 traceability. Technical files for compliance audits are part of the deliverable.

faq.question: Do you have a US, EU or UK office?
faq.answer: Proud Tek operates from Shenzhen with no overseas office. We support buyers globally in English, with Chinese, Spanish and Arabic available on request. Local logistics partners handle DHL, FedEx and EMS delivery.
